column3: “how” renders the object marker “this”; “there was no spirit in them any longer” follows the Hebrew.
“perished” renders “was finished”; “to give us” follows the Hebrew.
“they had not circumcised them” renders the impersonal “people had not circumcised them.”
“So the name of that place is called” renders “and he called the name of that place.” “Gilgal” sounds like the Hebrew for “rolled away.”
NASB moves “on that very day” forward; “parched grain” renders “roasted grain.”
“No, rather I indeed come now as captain of the host” renders “No, for I am the commander of the army of the LORD; now I have come.” “No” follows the Hebrew reading “not.”
“the Lord’s host” uses a lowercase “Lord” for “Yahweh”; “sandals” and “feet” are plural for the Hebrew singulars.
